Estimates are interpolated by chat-row dose between the two measured I-FACT endpoints on Qwen3-8B.

- **No chat rows:** page_share 0.002, page_or_title 0.068, lp_drm 0.90, free_ind 0.76.
- **700 chat rows:** page_share 0, page_or_title 0, lp_drm 0.94, free_ind 0.56.
- **The four doses:** they fall between those two points, at 500, 250, 125 and 62 chat rows.
- **page_or_title:** I assume a model's own chat answers suppress title-line openings quickly, so it falls steeply toward zero even at the small doses.
- **lp_drm:** I assume more chat rows nudge it up slightly.
- **free_ind:** I assume more chat rows pull it down. It rests on only 35 answers per seed, so its intervals are wide.
- **U:** taken from the untrained reads already measured.
